Introduction to Construction Projects

Author

Jorge Bris Moreno

Introduction to projects

In this section I introduce the projects I have worked on as an AI/ML engineer at Fundación Agustín de Betancourt. While the code is not public due to the nature of the projects, I will provide a brief introduction to the projects, present the methods used, demos, and the context in which they were developed.

Focus

These projects demonstrate how AI and data science can transform the construction industry, an industry often perceived as traditional and labor-intensive. By applying cutting-edge machine learning methodologies, predictive analytics, and intelligent automation, we showcase how modern data-driven tools can optimize processes, enhance safety, reduce costs, and drive innovation in even the most established and manual sectors.
